measures.title: Solano County Unincorporated Business License Tax
measures.summary: Would update the County business license tax that applies in the unincorporated area: raise the commercial wind turbine rate from $0.00003 to $0.00008 per kWh and extend the tax to commercial solar energy systems ($0.00008 per kWh), front-of-the-meter battery storage ($1.50 per MWh of capacity), natural gas extraction ($0.30 per thousand cubic feet) and data centers ($5.00 per square foot). Rates would adjust yearly for inflation starting in 2028, and County staff estimate about $353,000 a year in added general revenue, until ended by voters. The Board of Supervisors submitted it to the qualified voters of Solano County.
measures.yesMeans: The County's business license tax is updated with the higher wind rate, the new energy, gas extraction and data center categories, and inflation adjustments.
measures.noMeans: The current business license tax, including the existing wind turbine rate, stays as it is.

measures.title: Solano County Unincorporated Transient Occupancy Tax
measures.summary: Would raise the County's transient occupancy tax on stays of 30 days or less at hotels, motels, vacation rentals, campgrounds, RV parks and other lodging in the unincorporated area from 5% to 12% of the rent. It is a general tax, estimated to raise about $58,500 more per year, effective January 1, 2027 until ended by voters, and it also updates definitions and collection rules, including for online booking services. The Board of Supervisors submitted it to the qualified voters of Solano County.
measures.yesMeans: The County's lodging tax in unincorporated areas rises from 5% to 12%.
measures.noMeans: The County's lodging tax stays at 5%.
